name: Aperture by Tailscale
desc: Self-hosted AI gateway that puts every model call behind one identity-aware door.
desc_zh: 自托管的 AI 网关，把全组的模型调用收进一道按身份鉴权的门后。
solves: API keys get copied into every agent and CLI, so nobody sees who spent what or can revoke a leaked one; Aperture holds keys and logs each call.
solves_zh: 密钥被复制进每个 agent 和 CLI，没人知道谁花了多少、泄露了也收不回；Aperture 统一保管密钥并记录每次调用。
best_for: You are about to hand a coding agent a provider API key and want the team to share one gateway instead.
best_for_zh: 准备把模型 API 密钥直接交给编程 agent 时，改用全组共用的一个网关入口。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://tailscale.com/blog and https://tailscale.com/changelog (then C: Appi）。 Not in the ledger, so this is a rule-(b) candidate even though the first public date is before the window. Timeline from first-party pages: private alpha post 2026-01-27, public beta 2026-04-23, alpha via self-serve 2026-03-23 (this date), GA recorded in the changelog under 2026-08-25 with a GA blog post dated 2026-08-26. tailscale.com/aperture redirects to the homepage used here. 首次公开日期来源：https://tailscale.com/blog/aperture-self-serve
